第一千六百六十六章恶之本相
“你的本事也就那么回事，多一个少一个，对于我而言不过是多用点时间和少用点时间的区别罢了。”萧叶说着，丝毫没有将二人放在眼里。
连一个法象境三层都没有达到，现在的他确实有些看不上。
这是他的狂傲，他也有狂傲的资本。
空间立场，划分天下。绕指柔在这空间立场当中，好似变成了无数的鸿蒙道宝，连恶僧都感觉到了恐惧，这若是刺来，自己身上还不多出来无数的窟窿？
可灵祸妖的手段还是超过了萧叶的预期，本身就是空间的产物，修炼的也只有空间之力。空间立场在灵祸妖的面前，似乎起不到什么作用，它就如同一个横冲直撞的铁牛，立场频频破碎。
恶僧也在此刻，脱离萧叶的掌控拉开距离。
灵祸妖结结实实的撞在萧叶的肉体上，萧叶感受着空间与空间的碰撞，身上的空间神经网络，在这么一个撞击之下又分裂出了无数的支点网络。
萧叶感受着身体的变化和异样，同样的空间之力的相碰，只会让自身的神经网络更加的庞大且复杂，很有可能会超过身体所能承受的范围，届时空间系统紊乱，身体会直接面临奔溃。
这与刚刚恶僧那钢之法则的佛珠撞击自己的情况不同，那佛珠撞击在身上以后则是被全身上下的空间网络给散开，游走在每一条神经网络，最后快速的消散其中的能量。
萧叶还在感受身体的变化，恶僧则是相当的会抓住时机。
身体的身后，出现了一个罗汉法相，手中水磨禅杖高高举起，随后用力的落下。
“孽障，老衲这就送你去西方极乐世界见佛祖！”恶僧挥动禅杖，拥有月牙弯刃的一端搅动风云，虚空碎裂，出现了无数的碎片，大地也出现了一个看不到的无形的龙卷。
萧叶站在原地巍然不动，他的眼神看向了别处。
这种情况自是一个幌子，恶僧作为一名炼器师，自然是要配合上身上的宝物来战斗的。若不然，炼制那么多的宝物，岂不是浪费了。
砰！
萧叶看准了那虚空中，肉眼看不到的佛珠，用力的一件落下。谁知，百万剑落在佛珠之上，那佛珠忽然的爆炸，其威力简直就相当于踏天境强者的自爆。
萧叶的身子在这爆炸之下急速后退，虽然伤不到他，但也着实麻烦。
他看着手中的百万剑，此刻散发着鲜艳的红光，蠢蠢欲动，似乎被那股爆炸给激怒了一样。
萧叶的金瞳看着黑色的佛珠，压制了自己的阳火，能够很明显的感知到其中的灵魂。各种的都有，下到凡人，上到法象境强者的灵魂，全部都被炼化到了那佛珠当中。

每一次的爆炸，其实都是那些灵魂的爆炸，只需要这恶僧一点的灵力就能够驱动。
这看得萧叶愈发的愤怒起来，这恶僧比起影族还要让人恶心厌恶。
影族好歹是面对敌人，这个恶僧，面对的则是同类。
看着萧叶露出破绽，灵祸妖抓住机会便是杀来。身体的双臂化作了长枪，用力的朝着萧叶刺来。
萧叶甚至于没有多看一眼，身体本能的躲避，相位空间施展，又一次的把灵祸妖给打飞出去。在相同的空间维度之下，灵祸妖那所谓的灵化，根本起不到半点的作用。
“这东西也太废物了吧，没有了灵化，感觉还不如一头畜生好使。”恶僧看着灵祸妖的表情暗骂，一脸的鄙夷，他没有想到萧叶也能够进入灵祸妖那般灵化的状态，如此一来，灵祸妖可谓是遇到了天敌。
恶僧转身就要离开，可萧叶比他更快，直接拦住了退路。
金色的火焰渲染天空，紫色的神雷惩戒大地。
雷霆若是一根根的擎天巨柱，疯狂的从那九霄之上落下。金色的光芒笼罩恶僧，雷霆落在身体上同样是散发出金属的声音。紫色的佛珠闪亮，周围的空间扭曲，神雷直接拐了一个弯。
萧叶见状，一掌汇出，空间月刃朝着那扭曲的空间斩下，可月刃在半空中被灵祸妖所湮灭。空间的扭曲，威严的绞杀。
无数的透明利刃斩断虚空，斩断火焰，斩断雷霆而来。
砰砰！
content_en:
Chapter 1,666 The True Nature of Evil
"That's all you have. One more and one less. To me, it's just the difference between using more time and using less time." Xiao Ye said, not taking the two of them seriously at all.
He has not even reached the third level of Dharma Realm, and he really looks down on it now.
This is his arrogance, and he also has the capital to be arrogant.
Space attitude divides the world. Ringing Zhirou seemed to have turned into countless Hongmeng Taoist treasures in this spatial position. Even the evil monk felt fear. If this was stabbed, wouldn't there be countless holes in his body?
But the methods of the Spiritual Disaster Demon still exceeded Xiao Ye's expectations. It was itself a product of space, and it only cultivated the power of space. The spatial stance seems to have no effect in front of the Spirit Calamity Demon. It is like a rampaging iron bull, with its stance frequently broken.
At this moment, the evil monk broke away from Xiao Ye's control and distanced himself.
The Spirit Calamity Demon slammed into Xiao Ye's body firmly. Xiao Ye felt the collision between space and space. The spatial neural network on his body split into countless fulcrum networks under such an impact.
Xiao Ye felt the changes and strangeness in his body. The collision of the same space power will only make his own neural network larger and more complex, which may exceed the range that the body can bear. At that time, the space system will be disordered and the body will directly face collapse.
This is different from the situation where the evil monk's Buddhist beads of steel law hit him just now. After the beads hit his body, they were scattered by the space network all over his body, wandering in every nerve network, and finally dissipated the energy quickly.
Xiao Ye was still feeling the changes in his body, but the evil monk was quite good at seizing the opportunity.
Behind the body, an Arhat appeared. He raised the water mill Zen staff high in his hand, and then dropped it hard.
"Evil barrier, I will send you to the Western Paradise to meet the Buddha!" ​​The evil monk waved his Zen staff, and the end with the crescent-shaped curved blade stirred the wind and clouds. The void shattered, countless fragments appeared, and an invisible invisible tornado appeared on the earth.
Xiao Ye stood still, his eyes looking elsewhere.
This situation is a pretense. As a weapon refiner, the evil monk naturally has to fight with the treasures on his body. Otherwise, refining so many treasures would be a waste.
Bang!
Xiao Ye spotted the Buddha beads that were invisible to the naked eye in the void, and dropped them one by one with all his strength. Unexpectedly, when a million swords fell on the Buddha beads, the Buddha beads suddenly exploded, and its power was simply equivalent to the self-destruction of a strong man in the Heaven-Stepping Realm.
Xiao Ye's body retreated rapidly under the explosion. Although it couldn't hurt him, it was still troublesome.
He looked at the Million Sword in his hand, which was glowing with bright red light and ready to move, as if he was angered by the explosion.
Xiao Ye looked at the black Buddha beads with his golden eyes, suppressed his Yang Fire, and could clearly sense the soul inside. There are all kinds of souls, ranging from mortals to the souls of powerful people in the Dharma Realm, all of which have been refined into the Buddha beads.
Every explosion is actually an explosion of those souls, and it only requires a little bit of spiritual power from the evil monk to drive it.
This made Xiao Ye become even more angry. This evil monk was even more disgusting than the Shadow Clan.
ShadowClan is facing an enemy after all, and this evil monk is facing someone of his own kind.
Seeing Xiao Ye's flaws exposed, the Spiritual Disaster Demon seized the opportunity and came to kill him. The arms of the body turned into spears and stabbed Xiao Ye hard.
Xiao Ye didn't even take a second look. He instinctively avoided it and used phase space to knock the spirit evil demon away again. In the same spatial dimension, the so-called spiritualization of the Spiritual Disaster Demon has no effect at all.
"This thing is too useless. Without its spiritual transformation, it feels like it's not as useful as a beast." The evil monk looked at the expression of the spirit disaster demon and cursed secretly.With a look of disdain on his face, he did not expect Xiao Ye to be able to enter the spiritual state of the Spiritual Disaster Demon. In this way, the Spiritual Disaster Demon had met its natural enemy.
The evil monk turned around and was about to leave, but Xiao Ye was faster than him and blocked his retreat.
Golden flames paint the sky, and purple divine thunder punishes the earth.
If the thunder were like giant pillars holding up the sky, they would fall crazily from the sky. Golden light enveloped the evil monk, and the thunder falling on his body also gave off a metallic sound. The purple beads shone, the surrounding space was distorted, and the divine thunder turned a corner.
Seeing this, Xiao Ye moved his palms together and slashed the space moon blade towards the twisted space, but the moon blade was annihilated by the spirit evil demon in mid-air. The distortion of space, the majestic strangulation.
Countless transparent sharp blades cut through the void, cut through the flames, and cut through the thunder.
Bang bang!
